question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

13, 21, 33, 54, 91,?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **The series follows the pattern of double difference. 

Difference of square of consecutive numbers 2, 3, 4, 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d249c50a3b3e93deaa46787d5613b7ebcb0bc5ac6dd617d62f222d0e8e1d1ba.png] 

So, '153' will complete the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"153"**
